import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorSheafProduct
import HartshorneLib.Chapter2CohomologyFunctoriality
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RegularDifferentialSheaf

/-!
# Divisor cohomology products and the differential-valued pairing

Multiplication by global divisor sections induces the bilinear product
`H^n(O(D)) x H^0(O(E)) -> H^n(O(D + E))`. For complementary divisors this
gives a pairing into the cohomology of regular differentials. The pairing
depends on the specified nonzero rational differential identifying `O(K)`
with regular differentials. No scalar trace or perfectness is assumed or
proved here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

/-- Cohomology multiplication by a degree-zero class, constructed from its
global section and the resulting coefficient-sheaf morphism. -/
def divisorCohomologyProduct (D E : CurveDivisor k X) (n : ℕ) :
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k (divisorSheaf D) n →ₗ[k]
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k (divisorSheaf E) 0 →ₗ[k]
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k
        (divisorSheaf (D + E)) n :=
  ((CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.mapLinear n).comp
    ((divisorSheafMulSectionLinear D E).comp
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
        (isTerminalTop : IsTerminal (⊤ : X.left.Opens))
        (divisorSheaf E)).toLinearMap)).flip

@[simp]
lemma divisorCohomologyProduct_apply (D E : CurveDivisor k X) (n : ℕ)
    (c : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k (divisorSheaf D) n)
    (s : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k (divisorSheaf E) 0) :
    divisorCohomologyProduct D E n c s =
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.map
        (divisorSheafMulSection D E
          (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ isTerminalTop
            (divisorSheaf E) s)) n c := rfl

/-- In degree zero, the cohomology product is exactly the product of global
sections under the existing degree-zero identification. -/
theorem divisorCohomologyProduct_zero (D E : CurveDivisor k X)
    (c : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k (divisorSheaf D) 0)
    (s : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k (divisorSheaf E) 0) :
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ isTerminalTop
        (divisorSheaf (D + E)) (divisorCohomologyProduct D E 0 c s) =
      divisorSectionsMul D E ⊤
        (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ isTerminalTop (divisorSheaf D) c)
        (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ isTerminalTop (divisorSheaf E) s) := by
  rw [divisorCohomologyProduct_apply,
    ← CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀_naturality]
  rw [divisorSheafMulSection_app, divisorSectionsRes_id]
  rfl

/-- The bilinear divisor pairing with values in regular-differential
cohomology. Its degree-one specialization is the pairing before the Serre trace. -/
def divisorDifferentialCohomologyPairing
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (D : CurveDivisor k X) (n : ℕ) :
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k (divisorSheaf D) n →ₗ[k]
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k
        (divisorSheaf (differentialDivisor X ω hω - D)) 0 →ₗ[k]
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat)) k
        (regularDifferentialSheaf X) n := by
  let f : divisorSheaf (D + (differentialDivisor X ω hω - D)) ⟶
      regularDifferentialSheaf X :=
    divisorSheafLE (le_of_eq (show D + (differentialDivisor X ω hω - D) =
      differentialDivisor X ω hω by abel)) ≫ (regularDifferentialSheafIso X ω hω).hom
  exact (LinearMap.compRight _ (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.map f n)).comp
    (divisorCohomologyProduct D (differentialDivisor X ω hω - D) n)

end
end Hartshorne
